Compare quality-vs-cost Pareto, do not infer speed benefit from complexity.

priority_findings.mechanism: Both hybrid modes lock FastFill sizes. Repair skips the LLM whenever the tidied draft has zero workflow_problems; later selection only accepts strictly fewer problem messages. These checks cover supplied constraints and geometric violations, not general implicit furniture-group function/appearance or a VLM quality objective. A functionally better equal-count layout is discarded in repair mode.

evidence.interpretation: Chair is 2m from table centre and faces away. No user relation is supplied; simple geometric constraints pass. Actual solve({},NO_MODEL,None,condition,layout,repair,2) returns before chat.

priority_findings.relevance: Can retain poor chair/table/sofa/TV arrangements after a stage labelled repair and spend extra calls without selecting semantic improvement. This is a concrete local mechanism, not established cause of screenshot staged/c_final scores because those run IDs are unavailable.
priority_findings.minimal_action: Expose raw, tidy-only, size-locked placement, hard-constraint repair as separate stages; add explicit functional tests and preserve Pareto candidate records. First compare size-free one-call and size-locked one-call on identical requests to determine whether size freezing creates the gap.

priority_findings.mechanism: Successful room_k cache is reused based only on file existence/error, without validating rows/model/method/draft binding; hybrid writes a new RUN.json before reuse.
priority_findings.relevance: If the screenshot experiment reused these scripts/directories, rows can be attributed to a new configuration even though generated previously. No claim that this happened to the screenshot.
priority_findings.minimal_action: Audit cache request/model/hash bindings before any rerun; require immutable run manifest and new directory on mismatch. Re-score existing raw outputs after establishing identities, no paid rerun needed.

priority_findings.mechanism: layout_quality skips None before computing NAV and per-object relation/access/collision aggregates; support_accuracy likewise skips missing predictions. The reported room count remains visible but metric means are conditional, unlike an all-request success measure.

evidence.input: two copies of first probe20 row, layouts=[target,None]

priority_findings.relevance: Cannot treat 19-room c_final and 20-room methods as directly paired means. This proves the local scorer behavior only; screenshot scorer and missing reason not found.
priority_findings.minimal_action: Publish all-request completion/success plus common-19 paired score and full-20 conditional score. Identify missing room/reason. Average repeated judges within room and estimate uncertainty across rooms, not across 60 correlated calls.

priority_findings.mechanism: Decoder/export retains predicted parent, but runtime reconcile overwrites it with request support; validator also uses request support. For unknown-support inventory, predicted floor parent becomes None and support remains unknown.
priority_findings.relevance: The user task omits mesh/support ground truth. A support head cannot establish operational end-to-end support through this path even if predicted correctly. Conservative rejection is safer than false acceptance, but capability claim must be restricted.
priority_findings.minimal_action: Use one declared/predicted candidate-support contract with provenance, verify against real geometry, retain unknown where verification missing.

additional_conditional_risks.scope: If screenshot stages use --from-head-outputs on E, cache replay changes geometry; exact screenshot path not known.
additional_conditional_risks.action: Do not mix online E with re-decoded cached E until support_logits is serialized/versioned.

additional_conditional_risks.scope: Only benchmark_request(scene) path, not all request entry points.
additional_conditional_risks.mechanism: Reconstructs request from room dimensions and furniture descriptions plus GT place_id support_parent, omitting source doors/windows/polygon. This is not empty observed shell plus unknown support as specified.
additional_conditional_risks.action: Use canonical observed shell with openings and only authorizable furniture data; label GT support as privileged/oracle track.

conclusion: Do not dismiss the observed ranking as judge bias. Treat it as a real warning for the tested protocol while separating data/aggregation/engineering errors from remaining model/task quality. Current checkout cannot establish screenshot ranking cause; it does establish repair objective mismatch, unbound caches, survivor-only metrics and support contract gap.
